outcome: reference intervals for umbilical cord blood direct bilirubin
reference intervals for umbilical cord blood indirect bilirubin
reference intervals for umbilical cord blood total bilirubin
reference intervals for umbilical cord blood creatinine
reference intervals for umbilical cord blood sodium
reference intervals for umbilical cord blood chloride
reference intervals for umbilical cord blood potassium
reference intervals for umbilical cord blood plasma glucose
cohort: Healthy term neonates with normal birth weight born to pregnant mothers without health issues in an Indian tertiary care hospital.
finding: This pioneering study established specific reference intervals for eight biochemical parameters in umbilical cord blood of newborns in western India.
mod_finding: Statistically significant differences were observed in cord blood serum sodium, potassium, and plasma glucose levels when comparing different delivery modes.
cross-section timing: At birth, from umbilical cord blood samples.
